title: 1823 Prairie gains its rear chimney and the light beside its door
items: The Dent house at 1823 Prairie now has the tall chimney its 1880s engraving and the 1883 album drawing both show, rising from the rear wing behind the north side.
The narrow window beside the front door, between the door and the projecting south bay, is now on the main floor as well as the one above.
